**

Hanneslabauer in Tirol

** **

Discover Authentic Tyrolean Hospitality

** Welcome to **Hanneslabauer**, where tradition meets warmth in the heart of **Tirol**. Nestled in the breathtaking landscapes of the **Alps**, our family-run inn invites you to experience the true spirit of **Tirol**—cozy mountain charm, hearty cuisine, and unforgettable hospitality. **

Our Home in the Mountains

** Perched in the picturesque region of **Tirol**, **Hanneslabauer** offers a serene retreat surrounded by lush forests, rolling meadows, and stunning alpine vistas. Whether you're seeking relaxation or adventure, our idyllic location is the perfect base for exploring the wonders of **Tirol**. **

Tyrolean Cuisine at Its Best

** Indulge in our rustic yet refined dishes, crafted with locally sourced ingredients. Savor the flavors of **Tirol** with classics like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Schlutzkrapfen**, and hearty **Gröstl**. Our menu changes seasonally, ensuring every visit brings a new culinary delight. **

Relax & Unwind

** After a day of hiking, skiing, or sightseeing, unwind in our cozy **Stube** (common room) with a glass of **Tiroler Apfelstrudelwein** or a steaming cup of **Kaffee mit Schlag**. Our warm, inviting atmosphere makes every moment feel like home. **

Adventure Awaits

** **Tirol** is a paradise for outdoor enthusiasts. From skiing in **Innsbruck** and **St. Anton** to hiking in the **Zillertal** or exploring the charming towns of **Lienz** and **Kitzbühel**, endless adventures call your name. We’re happy to help you plan your perfect day! **

Why Choose Hanneslabauer?

** - **Family-run warmth** – Experience genuine **Tiroler** hospitality. - **Prime location** – Close to nature’s wonders and cultural gems. - **Authentic flavors** – Taste the best of **Tirol**’s culinary traditions. - **Memorable stays** – Whether for one night or longer, we welcome you with open arms. **

Visit Us

** Come and be part of the **Hanneslabauer** family. Whether you're here for the breathtaking scenery, the rich culture, or simply to escape the hustle, we promise an experience you’ll cherish. **

We look forward to welcoming you in Tirol!
